rows.name: Link sent again
rows.text: We have sent the link again to your email. If it is not in your inbox in a few minutes, look in spam or promotions.

rows.name: Changes after sealing
rows.text: A sealed wish cannot be changed, so it opens exactly as you made it. If something is wrong, reply here with what and we will look at it with you.

rows.name: Taken down
rows.text: We have taken it down. Nobody can open it now, the sender included.

rows.name: How to keep a wish
rows.text: Open the wish in the app and pick a keep: one more month, six months or a year.
